Poco X8 and Poco X8 Power are mid-range smartphones with massive battery the X8 Power has a 10,000 mAh battery with 100W charging and comes with 6.83" 1.5K AMOLED Screen with Dolby Vision support and comes with the new Snapdragon 6 Gen 5 processor and the Poco X8 comes with Snapdragon 6s Gen 4 and 9000 mAh battery.
This video is in with POCO India and the smartphone was provided to me by the company but all the testing and pictures captured were done independently by me and the smartphone will be going back to the company after a few weeks.
